test_title: PYST 07: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) EH - BE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e399937eebb60df73f84a4520b2920339a49082df6c4d45bae08d0208b51734.png] 

Option 2) GJ - DG

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6848ce3f7e00c767cd3e4ecc69d04a77dd5f781162879f10b468f0e969deba9.png] 

Option 3) RK - JH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/193b623674805ae2922477af881e266cb5287a26303f16f331c664dc99e38cb8.png] 

Option 4) PS - MP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fa88b8db308d3e5a74106906673a017e88f188e079b17f8a2af8e9defc7dc5e.png] 

Thus, out of all 'RK - JH' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
